description.value:
Your mastery of earth allows you to infuse your own self with the essence of the mountain.

As an Action, you undergo the transformation and gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

  • Your size changes the huge and you gain temporary hit points equal to three times your kineticist level.
  • You are Immune to the Charmed, Exhausted, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned conditions.
  • You ignore all earth-based effects such as the Erupting Earth spell or even a natural earthquake.
  • When you move for the first time on your turn, your steps shake the earth. All creatures of your choice within 60 feet of you have to make a Strength Saving Throw against your save DC or be knocked Prone.

Once you have used this ability, you can't use it again until you have finished a Long Rest.
